prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent enemy sprite for the existing dark-fantasy game. The four input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, never subjects to copy. Match their chunky, stepped pixel blocks, dark warm near-black outlines, muted cream/bone, rust brown, antique brass and charcoal steel palette, and upper-left highlights. Single complete isolated creature/object, three-quarter battle view toward screen left, no environment or ground shadow. It should look drawn at roughly 112x140 logical pixels and enlarged with nearest-neighbor to about 1120x1400: hard square 10px blocks, 1–2 block outline, approximately 3–7 broad shade bands, no dithering or smooth shading. Use a small coherent palette (up to 32 colors). Fully transparent empty background, fully opaque sprite, no translucent effects or antialiased edges. No lettering, UI, border, watermark or labels. Do not add traits, props or weapons absent from the following source description. Weakness elements are metadata, not visual powers.
Source: design/enemies.json enemy tangled_riders; name 뒤엉킨 기마; family 18 초원의 기마; original grade mob; art grade mob. Exact appearance (authoritative Korean): 말과 기수가 한 덩어리로 뒤엉킨 망자
Source actions for pose or explicitly named equipment only: 짓밟기, 창 찌르기, 질주.
ONE cohesive composite enemy sprite. Include exactly the multiple constituent figures or bodies stated in the source, fused or grouped as described; no lineup or separate variants. Keep the entire silhouette and all tips inside frame with generous transparent margins. No scenery, floor or detached background fragments. Any source inscriptions must be abstract tiny marks, never legible lettering. No new heraldry or invented decoration.
Faithful English translation of the source appearance: An undead horse and rider entangled into a single mass.
PRIORITY: The exact source subject and material override every reference subject. References show pixel technique only. Do not copy their puppet anatomy, brass armor, face plates, smoke vents, or accessories into an enemy that is not described with those features. Use the stated source anatomy and stated props visibly. All mandatory source props must be readable in the silhouette. No readable letters; source inscriptions are tiny abstract marks.
EDIT REQUEST. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, not a generic style reference. Preserve this exact enemy design, same compact composition, same relative proportions, palette, source equipment and pixel technique. Change only the framing: shrink the entire subject into the central 70 percent of a larger fully transparent canvas, with at least 15 percent empty transparent margin on ALL FOUR sides. Complete only the tiny currently clipped rightmost tail. Keep the entire subject and every tip wholly inside the frame. Do not add any other objects or anatomy. Do not zoom in. No background, ground, shadow, text or labels. All sprite pixels fully opaque; background transparent.
